name: analysis-workflow
description: Conventions for analysis repos where humans and coding agents work side by side: versioned task directories for both, one session, worktree and PR per agent task; worktree-safe output paths; additive write-back to AnnData zarr working objects. Ships a skill, guard hooks and the analysis_workflow Python package.

deliverables.title: Default deliverables
deliverables.description: What a task delivers unless you choose otherwise at its start, e.g. "a figure" or "a figure and a report". Blank: the agent asks.
